snippet.title: Once a Legend, Forever a Legend..!#blackmyth
snippet.description:
Black Myth: Wukong is a 2024 action RPG by Game Science based on the Chinese novel Journey to the West. Players act as the "Destined One," a staff-wielding monkey fighting monsters and bosses to recover Sun Wukong's six senses. Known for high-fidelity graphics (Unreal Engine 5), the game features fast-paced, dodge-heavy combat, magic spells, and transformations
Key Aspects of the Game

Genre & Setting: Third-person action RPG set in a dark fantasy world based on Chinese mythology.

Combat System: Fast-paced, focusing on dodges and varied staff techniques. Players can unlock and use various spells, such as immobilizing enemies, and transform into creatures to utilize their unique abilities.

Narrative: The story follows the "Destined One" as they journey to uncover the truth beneath the legend of Sun Wukong, the Monkey King.

Structure: It is a linear action game, not open-world, structured into chapters with numerous bosses.

Platform & Release: Released August 20, 2024, on PlayStation 5 and Windows, with an Xbox Series X/S release on August 20, 2025.

PC SPECS :
LENOVO LOQ 
I5 12TH GEN 
24GB RAM AND 500GB SSD
RTX 4050 GRAPHICS CARD

snippet.title: Turbo V8 LS-swap Nissan 200SX v BMW M2: DRAG RACE
snippet.description:
It’s a RWD showdown! 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-2411

What chance do high-powered drift cars have going head-to-head against a BMW M2 in a drag race? 

Well, it’s time to find out! We’ve got Mat lining up in the standard BMW M2, and he’s going head-to-head against a Nissan 200SX and a Mercedes E-Class Limo, both of which have been tuned to specialise in drifting! This means they’re packing a whole load of performance, but will they be able to put it down over a straight line? Let’s take a closer look at the stats… 

Starting with the Nissan, it’s powered by a 6.3-litre Chevy V8 and a massive single turbo, and it puts down 804hp and 1,030Nm. This power is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed sequential gearbox, and all-in it’s valued at £130,000. 

Up next we have the Mercedes E-Class Limo. Under the bonnet there’s a 6-litre Chevy V8 and a set of twin turbos! It puts down an enormous 700hp and 1000Nm, with this power sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox. The combined cost of the car and the mods is around £100,000. 

Finally, we come to the M2. It’s stock, which means it has a 3-litre twin-turbo straight-six under the bonnet, and this creates 480hp and 600Nm. Power is sent to the rear wheels via an 8-speed auto, and it costs £71,645. 

So they’re all equipped with RWD, but will the less-powerful M2 snatch the win? There’s only one way to find out for sure… LET’S RACE!

snippet.title: 5 Minutes de Préparation pour ces Mini-Bûches Raffaello 😍 SANS CUISSON 🎄
snippet.description:
🎄 Mini-bûches façon Raffaello SANS CUISSON 🥥

Des biscuits moelleux enrobés de noix de coco, une crème mascarpone fondante et des framboises pour une petite touche acidulée. Un dessert de Noël facile à préparer à l’avance ! 😍

‼️ Petit détail que j’ai oublié de préciser dans la vidéo 🤍 Laissez les mini-bûches au moins 4 heures au réfrigérateur avant de les déguster. Les biscuits auront le temps de s’attendrir et la crème de bien se tenir.

Les ingrédients: 
- 250 g de crème liquide entière (30 % MG) bien froide
- 250 g de mascarpone
- 2 c. à soupe de crème de coco goût Raffaello, ou plus selon vos goûts
  Vous pouvez la remplacer par environ 100 g de chocolat blanc fondu et tiédi + 2 c. à soupe de noix de coco râpée.
- Un peu de vanille
- 20 biscuits à la cuillère ou boudoirs
- Du lait pour tremper les biscuits
- De la noix de coco râpée pour les enrober

Pour la déco ✨
Framboises, feuilles de menthe et Raffaello coupés en deux.

snippet.title: Dancing With the Stars Season 35 WINNER Revealed | E! News
snippet.description:
Dancing With the Stars’ new champion sprinted straight to the top. During the season 35 finale, Ezra Frech and partner Daniella Karagach secured the Mirrorball Trophy after making an incredible recovery from a prosthetic mishap during their freestyle—making Frech the first Paralympian to take home the title. And it's clear the pair found their rhythm, delivering show-stopping routines during the Nov. 24 episode. In addition to receiving perfect scores by judges Derek Hough, Carrie Ann Inaba and Bruno Tonioli, Ezra also becomes the first amputee to win the show and the youngest man to win at 21, besting last year's champ Robert Irwin. "This is the most special moment of my life," Ezra shared. "Thank you, everybody, for voting. Thank you for believing in us. Oh my God." Daniella—earning her second Mirrorball following her victory with Iman Shumpert in season 30—added, "I'm just so freaking grateful." Of course, the 2026 champions achieving the sole purpose of the competition meant they outscored runner-up Amber Glenn, as well as Connor Wood, Tatyana Ali and Maura Higgins.
